architecture.mechanism: Increasing pressure improves cell performance, enhances stack consistency, and mitigates the impacts of temperature and humidity on membrane dehydration
architecture.intervention: Increase the operating pressure of the fuel cell stack while maintaining current density at 1.5 A/cm² and stack temperature at 80°C
architecture.expected_effect: Reduced membrane dehydration, lower ionic resistance, minimized hot spot formation, and maintained power output without significantly increasing cathode humidification load
architecture.falsification_test: Compare stack performance at 1.5 A/cm² and 80°C with normal pressure versus increased pressure (e.g., 150-200 kPa) while monitoring membrane hydration, resistance distribution, and power output
